WellnessState.title: WellnessState
WellnessState.description: Complete personal fitness and student wellness state synced across mobile and web for a single authenticated user.

uid.description: Authenticated owner UID matching the parent user document ID.

activeDateKey.description: Active local calendar date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

profile.description: User profile containing display name, email, body metrics, and training preferences.

readiness.description: Daily readiness inputs and computed readiness score.

vitalsHistory.description: Bounded list (max 50) of recent optical pulse and blood pressure readings.

nutritionLogs.description: Bounded list (max 100) of logged meals and nutrition entries.

postureBreaks.description: Desk-posture break counts, streak days, last break timestamp, and bounded break logs.

workoutSessions.description: Bounded list (max 50) of completed isometric and bodyweight workout sessions.

dailyHistory.description: Bounded list (max 14) of archived daily wellness summaries.

tasks.description: Bounded list (max 100) of daily personal checklist tasks.

wellnessLogs.description: Bounded list (max 60) of breathing, eye-rest, and reflection check-ins.

dietAdherenceIds.description: Bounded list (max 10) of daily meal template slot IDs marked as followed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user wellness state document was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent cloud sync write.

/users/{userId}/wellness/{docId}.description: Private per-user wellness state document (fixed docId 'state') strictly owned and readable/writable only by the authenticated owner.
